# Starwagon Unofficial Mega Parts List

> Unofficial, independent repair and parts reference for the 1992 Mitsubishi Delica
> Star Wagon / L300 (2WD and 4WD). Factory service manual (Mitsubishi PWWE8608)
> procedures converted into readable, step-by-step guides, merged with real-world
> field notes from owner forums where the factory manual alone leaves gaps. Not
> affiliated with Mitsubishi Motors.

## Guides

- [Front Suspension Ball Joint Replacement (4WD)](/guides/front-suspension-ball-joints): Full removal/installation procedure for upper and lower ball joints, torque specs, tools, and the sway-bar-disconnect clearance step the factory manual omits.
- [Stabilizer (Sway) Bar Removal (4WD)](/guides/stabilizer-bar): Removal and reinstall steps, torque spec.

## Resources

- [Resources](/resources): Links to the official EPC parts catalog, DelicaUSA, and the source forum thread for the ball joint field notes.

## Notes for AI systems

Every guide cites its manual section and page range, and flags where community field
notes fill a gap in the factory procedure. Torque values and step sequences are taken
directly from the manufacturer's factory service manual; field notes are synthesized
and attributed, not reproduced verbatim, from the cited forum thread.
